description: This file defines a function 'formatGeneratedModule' that formats source code using an external formatter ('oxfmt') or a fallback command, managing temporary files and handling process execution and errors.

methods.name: formatGeneratedModule
methods.description: Formats a given source string by writing it to a temporary file, invoking an external formatter ('oxfmt'), then reading back the formatted code. Handles platform differences and cleanup of temporary files.
